tools.name: split_costs
tools.description: Split one total cost across players (equally or by relative weights) and show who owes what plus the fewest settle-up payments.

tools.name: settle_up
tools.description: Given who paid what for a total cost, compute balances and the minimal set of payments to settle everyone.

tools.name: split_series
tools.description: Account for recurring sessions where different players attend different days: each session splits only among its attendees; returns who owes what and settle-up payments.

tools.name: rotation_plan
tools.description: Plan fair rotations for pickup games: who plays each round, who sits out, and games-played balance across the roster.
